Requires a qualifying smart thermostat connected to central air conditioning.

steps: Confirm you're an Xcel Energy New Mexico residential customer with central AC and a qualifying smart thermostat.
Enroll your thermostat in Thermostat Rewards on the Xcel Energy New Mexico page.
Allow small automatic adjustments during peak events (you can usually override them).
Receive your $100 one-time enrollment bill credit.
